author: Chase Davis
title: Emmet Sheehan fans seven but Dodgers fall short
desc: Emmet Sheehan allowed two earned runs on three hits and one walk while striking out seven over 5.1 innings in Sunday's loss to the Diamondbacks.
impact: Sheehan allowed seven hard hits and picked up 12 whiffs on 101 pitches. He ends the first half on a six-game skid of failing to complete six innings. He'll head into the All-Star break with a 4.81 ERA, 1.24 WHIP and 10.1 K/9 with a 4-6 record across 17 starts. The Phillies are on tap for him after the break.

author: Chase Davis
title: Lane Thomas racks up three hits in loss to Baltimore
desc: Lane Thomas went 3-for-4 in loss to the Orioles with a double and one RBI.
impact: After Sunday's loss to Baltimore, Thomas is batting .234 with seven home runs, 31 RBI, 26 runs scored and four stolen bases across 82 games. He's started 16 straight games, where he's batted .262 with two homers, seven runs scored, nine RBI and one steal.

author: Chase Davis
title: Matt Strahm implodes vs. Orioles
desc: Matt Strahm took the loss on Sunday, allowing five runs on four hits and a walk while striking out one against the Orioles.
impact: Strahm started his inning with a strikeout of Samuel Basallo before allowing a walk and four straight hits. He's been brutal since the start of June. In 15 innings since June 1, he has a 10.80 ERA, 1.73 WHIP and just a 4.8 K/9 with three holds and two losses.

author: Chase Davis
title: Seth Lugo fans six but exits early in 8-2 loss
desc: Seth Lugo allowed two earned runs on four hits and two walks while striking out six over four innings in Sunday's loss to the Orioles.
impact: Lugo exited early after piling up 89 pitches over his four innings. He allowed six hard-hit balls and picked up 11 whiffs. He heads into the All-Star break with a 4.56 ERA and 1.43 WHIP with a 3-6 record across 19 starts. He's expected to be second in the rotation coming out of the break.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Luis Arraez prefers to remain at 2B if traded
desc: Luis Arraez told reporters he wants to remain at second base if he is traded.
impact: Arraez added that he doesn't want to be traded away from the Giants. He seems like a likely trade candidate being on a one-year contract.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jake Irvin (shoulder) to begin rehab assignment Monday
desc: Jake Irvin will begin a rehab assignment on Monday in the Florida Complex League.
impact: Irvin has been on the injured list since late-May with a right shoulder strain. He will begin a lengthy rehab assignment.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Cam Sanders traded to Orioles, optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Orioles acquired RHP Cam Sanders from the Pirates for cash considerations and optioned him to Triple-A Norfolk.
impact: Sanders had been designated for assignment over the weekend. He will add relief depth in the Orioles organization.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Keegan Akin (elbow) transferred to 60-day IL
desc: The Orioles transferred RHP Keegan Akin to the 60-day injured list with elbow discomfort.
impact: Akin is scheduled to visit a specialist this week.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Alimber Santa optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Astros optioned RHP Alimber Santa to Triple-A Sugar Land.
impact: Santa returns to Triple-A heading into the All-Star break.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Mike Burrows (elbow) placed on IL
desc: The Astros placed Mike Burrows on the 15-day injured list with right elbow neuritis.
impact: Burrows was originally optioned to Triple-A, but he instead now lands on the IL. He does not hold a timetable to return.

author: Nate Miller
title: Bligh Madris released by Cardinals
desc: Bligh Madris was granted his release by the Cardinals.
impact: Madris will pursue playing opportunities overseas in Korea. The 30-year-old has spent the entire season with Triple-A, posting a strong .908 OPS with 14 homers over 71 games.

author: Nate Miller
title: Bruce Zimmerman sent to Triple-A
desc: Bruce Zimmerman was outrighted back to Triple-A on Sunday.
impact: Zimmerman was designated for assignment last week. The lefty reliever subsequently cleared waivers and was sent back to Triple-A by the Cardinals.

author: Nate Miller
title: Ha-Seong Kim (finger) will start a rehab assignment Monday
desc: Ha-Seong Kim (finger) will begin a rehab assignment with the FCL Braves on Monday.
impact: It's been a rough year for Kim. He didn't make his season debut until May 12. When he did finally get going, the 30-year-old shortstop struggled mightily at the plate, managing only five hits and nine walks over 82 plate appearances before being placed back on the IL at the end of June. Kim will pick things back up on Monday in Florida, hoping to reset for after the All-Star break.

author: Nate Miller
title: Ronald Acuna Jr. (hamstring) beginning rehab assignment
desc: Ronald Acuna Jr. (hamstring) will begin a rehab assignment on Monday.
impact: Acuna is progressing toward a return to the Braves' lineup, as he will get some in-game action at rookie ball in Florida on Monday. Acuna has been on the shelf for the past month due to his second hamstring injury of the season. The Braves have taken it slower this time with their star lead-off man, but their lineup has struggled to find consistency since Acuna went down.

author: Jesse Garcia
title: Shane Baz racks up 9 Ks but can't finish five in win
desc: Shane Baz allowed one earned run on seven hits and no walks while striking out nine over 4.2 innings in Sunday's 8-2 win over the Royals.
impact: After the outing, he owns a 4.11 ERA and 1.38 WHIP with a 4-9 record across 19 starts. Baz will likely pitch in the third game out of the All-Star break for the O's.
